scenarios.title: AC out, book a visit
scenarios.say: Hi, my AC's blowing warm air since this morning. Can somebody come out?
scenarios.expect: Jessie checks the calendar, offers up to three times, takes your name, phone, address and email, and books it.

scenarios.title: After-hours emergency
scenarios.say: It's 88 degrees in here and my elderly mom lives with me. The AC just died.
scenarios.expect: Jessie treats it as urgent, takes your details, says the on-call team will call back, and mentions the after-hours premium.

scenarios.title: Price curveball
scenarios.say: Just give me a price, how much to replace my AC?
scenarios.expect: Jessie gives the $5,000 to $12,000 typical range, never a firm quote, and offers the free in-home estimate.
